average_window: selected strain window; no automatic steady-state certification
contact_gap_use: pair contact onset; initial actual surface gaps are certified at or above this gap
normal_contact_law: linear spring; normal_stiffness in N/m; no Hertz conversion

packing.seed_proposal: random positions/quaternions with inscribed-spheroid PW rejection

periodic_images: all images in geometric support; self images included
preparation: geometric contact-clearance preparation; no physical equilibration

rotation_contact.model: elastic Coulomb rolling and twisting torques, active only at contact

rough_hydrodynamics.gap_rule: actual smooth-body gap and cap geometry; microscopic fluid gap uses gap_floor; contact onset is not subtracted from the smooth lubrication gap
rough_hydrodynamics.microstate_rule: exclude overlapping cap pairs and cap penetration into the opposite base; floor only nonnegative microscopic fluid gaps; no density renormalization
rough_hydrodynamics.model: finite-patch hard-core cap-pair tangential and rotational excess; positive shifted inverse microgap cutoff; normal baseline unchanged; dense-roughness correlations are an unresolved closure approximation

spectral_tolerance_scope: Fourier truncation only; not a total mobility or mesh error bound
step_geometry: endpoint actual-gap correction with frozen-geometry implicit force solves
surface_parameter_basis: exploratory model settings; not measured graphite parameters
